# Cycle 1 — Scaffolding & Shared Infrastructure

## Objective
Create the 85-folder directory tree (16 domains + `_shared/`) under each of the 5 layers (`api/v1/`, `models/`, `repositories/`, `services/`, `schemas/`), add `__init__.py` to every new sub-folder, move 16 cross-cutting files into their `_shared/` homes, relocate 3 existing sub-packages as atomic units, and delete the placeholder `core/` directory.

## Project vision
Reorganise `api/app/` from ~170 flat files across four domain layers into a layer-first, domain-clustered structure. Every domain name repeats identically across all layers that own it, so navigating to a domain folder is enough to find the file inside. The convention `Routes → Services → Repositories → Models` stays intact; only file locations change.

## Preceding cycles
None. This is the foundation cycle. The codebase today is entirely flat: 31 route files in `api/app/api/v1/`, 12 ORM models in `api/app/models/`, 15 repositories in `api/app/repositories/`, 38 service files (incl. 4 sub-packages) in `api/app/services/`, and 26 Pydantic schemas in `api/app/schemas/`. All internal imports use dotted paths without domain sub-folder segments (e.g. `from app.services.yfinance_data_service import YFinanceDataService`).

## Following cycles
- **Cycle 2** — Domain File Migration & Import Rewrite: git mv ~150 domain files into the scaffolding created here, then rewrite every import across the codebase to include the new sub-folder segments.
- **Cycle 3** — Tests, Docs & Verification: update ~124 test imports, refresh CLAUDE.md, run full test suite.

## In scope
- Create every sub-folder shown in the top-level tree: all 16 domains (`market_data`, `universe`, `macro`, `portfolio`, `optimization`, `backtest`, `factors`, `risk`, `rebalancing`, `views`, `attribution`, `dashboard`, `scenarios`, `reports`, `jobs`) plus `auth/` (models only) and `execution/` (models + repositories only), plus `_shared/` in every layer.
- Add `__init__.py` to every new sub-folder (~85 `__init__.py` files), each empty or with a minimal docstring.
- Move 4 `_shared` files in `api/v1/`: `router.py`, `metrics.py`, `database.py`, `test.py` → `api/v1/_shared/`.
- Move 1 `_shared` file in `models/`: `base.py` → `models/_shared/`.
- Move 2 `_shared` files in `repositories/`: `base.py`, `database_admin_repository.py` → `repositories/_shared/`.
- Move 7 `_shared` files in `services/`: `_price_fetcher.py`, `_sector_resolver.py`, `_json_safe.py`, `_progress.py`, `_benchmark_bootstrap.py`, `trading_calendar.py`, `notifications.py` → `services/_shared/`.
- Move 2 `_shared` files in `schemas/`: `base.py`, `base_job.py` → `schemas/_shared/`.
- Move 3 existing sub-packages as atomic units: `services/yfinance/` → `services/market_data/yfinance/`, `services/trading212/` → `services/universe/trading212/`, `services/scrapers/` → `services/macro/scrapers/`.
- Keep `services/infrastructure/` in place (already structured).
- Delete `api/app/core/` (placeholder directory with commented-out example code, no runtime imports depend on it).
- Verify folder count and structure match the proposal before proceeding.

## Out of scope
- Moving domain files (routes, services, schemas) beyond the `_shared/` and sub-package migrations listed above. All other files stay in their flat locations until Cycle 2.
- Rewriting import paths. Any import that breaks because a shared file or sub-package moved must be updated, but domain-file imports stay untouched.
- Updating `router.py` import paths for route files that haven't moved yet.
- Updating `models/__init__.py` for model files that haven't moved yet.
- Test file changes.
- CLAUDE.md updates.

## Acceptance criteria
- `api/app/core/` directory no longer exists.
- Every folder in the proposal's top-level tree exists with an `__init__.py`.
- All 16 shared files reside in their target `_shared/` sub-folders (confirmed by `ls`).
- `services/yfinance/`, `services/trading212/`, and `services/scrapers/` directories no longer exist at their old paths; their contents live at `services/market_data/yfinance/`, `services/universe/trading212/`, and `services/macro/scrapers/` respectively.
- `services/infrastructure/` remains at its original path.
- Imports referencing moved shared files or sub-packages resolve correctly (imports for unmoved domain files may still break — that is Cycle 2's responsibility).
- `git status` shows the expected additions and deletions with no unexpected artifacts.
cycle_2:
# Cycle 2 — Domain File Migration & Import Rewrite

## Objective
Move all remaining ~150 domain files from flat layers into their domain sub-folders per the 16-cluster mapping, then rewrite every internal import across the codebase so all dotted paths include the new sub-folder segment. Update `router.py` and `models/__init__.py` to match.

## Project vision
Same as Cycle 1. After this cycle, the folder reorganisation is functionally complete: every file lives under its domain cluster, every import resolves through the new paths, and the API boots and serves requests exactly as before.

## Preceding cycles
- **Cycle 1** delivered the 85-folder scaffolding with `__init__.py` in every sub-folder, moved 16 shared files to their `_shared/` homes, relocated `yfinance/`, `trading212/`, and `scrapers/` sub-packages to their domain folders, and deleted `core/`. The domain sub-folders exist but are empty (except for the sub-packages already moved).

## Following cycles
- **Cycle 3** — Tests, Docs & Verification: update all test imports, refresh CLAUDE.md, run full test suite and linters.

## In scope
- `git mv` every remaining domain file (~150 files) from flat layers into domain sub-folders per the 16-cluster mapping. Per-layer counts: api/v1 (26 files → 15 domains), models (10 → 10), repositories (12 → 11), services (28 → 14), schemas (24 → 15). For the exact file-to-domain mapping, see Cluster Details in the requirements document.
- Rewrite every internal import across `api/app/` so dotted paths include the domain sub-folder segment (e.g. `from app.services.optimization_service` → `from app.services.optimization.optimization_service`). Covers route files, service files, repository files, schema files, and all cross-layer references.
- Rewrite intra-package imports within moved sub-packages (`yfinance/`, `trading212/`, `scrapers/`) to use their new parent paths.
- Update `api/app/api/v1/_shared/router.py` — all 32 route imports must point to new sub-folder paths.
- Update `api/app/models/__init__.py` — all 10 model imports must point to new sub-folder paths. Confirm `__all__` is unchanged.
- Handle the `execution/` cross-cluster split: `models/execution/` and `repositories/execution/` are shared by both `optimization/` and `backtest/`. Imports must preserve this without circular dependencies.
- Preserve `macro_calibration.py` URL prefix `/views/macro-calibration` despite living in `api/v1/macro/` (data-ownership rule). Router prefix unchanged; only import path changes.

## Out of scope
- Creating new folders or `__init__.py` files (done in Cycle 1).
- Test file changes (Cycle 3).
- CLAUDE.md updates (Cycle 3).
- Running the test suite or linters (Cycle 3).
- Changing any runtime behaviour, URL prefixes, or API contracts.
- Renaming files — all files keep their current names; only their parent directory changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- No domain file remains at its old flat path; `git status` confirms every file moved via `git mv` (preserving history).
- `router.py` imports all route modules from their new sub-folder paths.
- `models/__init__.py` imports all ORM classes from their new sub-folder paths, and `__all__` is identical to the pre-move version.
- Every internal import across `api/app/` resolves to the correct new path. Grep for old flat patterns returns zero results across app code.
- The `execution/` cross-cluster split compiles without import errors; `OptimizationRun` and `BacktestRun` are importable from both `optimization/` and `backtest/` code paths.
- `macro_calibration` router still registers under `/views/macro-calibration`.
- The FastAPI app boots without `ModuleNotFoundError` on any import (import-level check; full runtime test is Cycle 3).

# Cycle 3 — Tests, Docs & Verification

## Objective
Update all import paths and patch targets across ~124 test files to match the new domain-folder layout, refresh CLAUDE.md's Architecture section, then run the full verification suite (api pytest, optimizer pytest, ruff, mypy, alembic autogenerate) to confirm zero regressions.

## Project vision
Same as Cycle 1. After this cycle the reorganisation ships: every import resolves, every test passes, docs match reality, and the CI pipeline stays green.

## Preceding cycles
- **Cycle 1** created the 85-folder scaffolding, moved 16 shared files to `_shared/` sub-folders, relocated 3 sub-packages (`yfinance/`, `trading212/`, `scrapers/`), and deleted `core/`.
- **Cycle 2** moved all ~150 domain files into their domain sub-folders and rewrote every internal import across `api/app/` so all dotted paths include the domain sub-folder segment.

## Following cycles
None. This is the final cycle. After verification passes, the branch is ready for PR review and merge.

## In scope
- Update import paths in all test files under `api/tests/unit/`, `api/tests/integration/`, `api/tests/repositories/`, and `api/tests/e2e/`. Every `from app.api.v1.<module> import ...`, `from app.models.<module> import ...`, `from app.repositories.<module> import ...`, `from app.services.<module> import ...`, and `from app.schemas.<module> import ...` must gain the domain sub-folder segment.
- Update `patch()` and `patch.object()` targets in tests. Any `@patch("app.services.optimization_service.OptimizationService")` must become `@patch("app.services.optimization.optimization_service.OptimizationService")`. This is the most error-prone part — mock targets are strings that do not fail at import time; they silently mock the wrong (or nonexistent) path.
- Verify `conftest.py` fixtures and `tests/__init__.py` imports are updated.
- Update CLAUDE.md — replace the flat `api/app/` file listing in the Architecture section with the new domain-folder tree. Keep the `Routes → Services → Repositories → Models` prose. The optimizer library section and frontend sections need no changes.
- Run `cd api && alembic check` or `alembic revision --autogenerate --sql` to confirm all models are discovered from their new paths and the schema is unchanged (no spurious new migration).
- Run `ruff check . --fix` and verify zero lint errors across both `api/` and `optimizer/`.
- Run `mypy api/` (or the configured strict-mode path) and verify zero new type errors.
- Run `cd api && pytest -v` and confirm all tests pass. Run `pytest tests/ -v` at the repo root to confirm the optimizer library tests are unaffected.
- Grep the full codebase for any remaining flat import pattern and fix any stragglers.

## Out of scope
- Moving files or creating folders (done in Cycles 1–2).
- Adding new tests or changing test logic. Only import paths and patch targets change; assertions and test data stay identical.
- Changing `pyproject.toml`, `requirements.txt`, or CI configuration.
- Frontend changes.
- Optimizer library changes.
- New features or bug fixes unrelated to the reorganisation.

## Acceptance criteria
- `cd api && pytest` passes with zero failures. Every test that passed before the reorganisation still passes.
- `pytest tests/ -v` passes at repo root (optimizer library unaffected).
- `ruff check .` reports zero errors on both `api/` and `optimizer/`.
- `mypy api/` reports zero new type errors.
- `alembic check` confirms the schema is detected correctly and no spurious migration is needed.
- Grep for old flat import paths returns zero results in test and app code that reference moved files.
- CLAUDE.md accurately describes the new folder layout with domain sub-folders per layer.
- The branch is ready for PR — all CI steps (ruff, mypy, pytest) are expected to pass.
